_provenance.notes: Valid ONLY at focus_absolute 134. The V4K reports no USB serial, so identity cannot be checked; verify the controls and frame size instead. Sheet is 8.5x11in, NOT the 10.5x12.5in ACME field-paper default the model ships with. punch_offset_mm is the PERPENDICULAR distance from the punched edge to the peg line; the scans cannot measure it, since only one perpendicular sheet edge is on the platen, so 12.0 is still nominal and unmeasured. Board marker size is recorded for board identity only: markerLength identifies corners, it is not a measurement input, and varying it 17-20 mm moves fx by 0.002 % and detects the same 1590 corners. Landmark heights measured 2026-09-21: the round landmark is the dome's sphere centre at 5.567 mm; the rect landmarks are HOLES in the paper plane, so 0. The rect value depends on ON-AXIS lighting keeping the open slot dark -- off-axis light lights the slot and the landmark becomes the peg top instead.
_provenance.peg_centre_spacing: Calipers 2026-09-25. Measured twice per pair so the peg sizes cancel: outer span (left edge of one peg to far edge of the next) 111.933 and 111.743 mm, clear gap between the same pairs 93.60 and 93.61. outer = spacing + (rect_long + round_dia)/2 and gap = spacing - the same, so spacing = (outer + gap)/2 = 102.767 and 102.677, mean 102.722 mm = 4.0442 in. No peg dimension is assumed. The paper's hole pitch is 101.616 mm from 95 scans, 1.11 mm narrower; the rect holes run 2.9 mm longer than the peg, so each rect peg sits about 0.55 mm off centre in its slot. That is the kinematic freedom along the bar working as designed.
_provenance.peg_rect_long_SUSPECT: The same readings give rect_long + round_dia = 18.233 mm, so with the round peg at 6.44 the rect peg is about 11.79 mm along the bar, not the 12.72 modelled. Unverified by direct measurement; it affects detection windows, not the fit.
